text:
zoe: Heads up — planning to kick off py/ts SDK canary at 04:00 PT. Quick split: py wheels + ts npm. One ask: confirm signer rotation didn't touch canary artifacts. Any objections to a fast pin if green?
dan: No objections, but I noticed a signer drift in staging last night. We should verify signatures before flipping disttag.
sasha: @dan can you paste the check you ran? I can run a quick sweep.
dan: Here's what I used:
```
gpg --verify dist/*.whl.sig dist/*.whl
# expecting 'Good signature' on all
```
One wheel failed earlier: `redwood_sdk-1.8.0-py3-none.whl` had a mismatched signer id.
kevin: If it's just one wheel, we can republish the wheel with correct signer and reuse same version? Prefer no version bump if identical build. But npm is probably fine to pin.
sasha: Republish requires yanking the old wheel from the internal index or reuploading the same filename — both are fiddly. We could hold the py disttag until republish completes.
zoe: OK plan: start canary for npm and py (excluding that wheel) at 04:00. If canary passes, pin npm and publish release notes. For py, hold disttag until we either republish or yank+reupload during the 2-hour change window. Agree?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary-started: py-sdk: cohort A (10 hosts) excluding wheel 'redwood_sdk-1.8.0-ambiguous.whl'; ts-sdk: cohort A (5 hosts). tracking -> https://deploys/redwood/canaries/4839201110
dan: I can republish at 05:15 if we decide to proceed. I'll prep the re-sign and staging test. If re-publish done, notify here and we flip py disttag.
release-manager: Add a short note in release_notes.md: 'Republished wheel due to signature rotation; no functional changes.' Also remember to call out deprecation for the legacy sync client in the changelog. I'll draft now.
kevin: Rollback criteria: if >2% error or latency spike >200ms p50 for 10m in canary, we abort and revert any disttag flips. If npm passes but py fails, we pin npm only and open a task for py republish.
deploy-bot: canary-health: 04:12 PT: py cohort A: healthy (errors 0.4%), ts cohort A: healthy (errors 0.2%). No latency breach. continuing to 04:30.
sasha: Ok I'm on re-signing standby. If you get any fail, ping me and I'll start republish.
zoe: :thumbsup: proceeding with staged plan. I'll update the release_notes and call out the deprecation snippet. Will check back at 04:30 before final pin.
